verdict.rationale: Origin-country guidance is a fair question for an immigration services provider. The evidence pack contains no country-specific pages, no consulate processing information, and no country-backlog guidance. Its resources are generic visa-pathway guides, such as F-1 to O-1, J-1 to O-1, O-1 vs EB-1, and startup founders. The J-1 page mentions the two-year home residency requirement only generically, not per country.
